subject: Calculating factor loadings for a custom item

messages.author: 9403604069d4685f
messages.subject: Calculating factor loadings for a custom item
parts:
Dear Phil,

I know that mirt doesn't calculate the factor loadings if the model contains items the user has defined using the createItem function because the user could have specified a null model. However, I was wondering if it is possible to calculate them manually and if you could point me to some formulae that I could use to do the calculation.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Calculating factor loadings for a custom item
parts:
mirt is open source, just look through the code-base to find the associated components and extract them as you need. Otherwise, you could find them in several articles related to item factor analysis. 

Phil
